_comment: Hand-maintained (data/ is hand-maintained; meta/ is generated - do not move this file).
Single source of truth for 'which non-black pixel count means which screen', consumed by
Keep in sync with docs/qemu-workflow.md ('Reading the results' and 'A generic codeplug'),
tools/examples/snake/README.md ('2. Verify under QEMU'), tests/test_image_snake.py, and
Where the docs disagree slightly (e.g. the ~4433 standby vs the 2990-4433 range) each
measurement keeps its own named entry rather than being silently merged.

boot-blank.notes: The first frame of the snake run's token line (boot).

boot-logo.notes: Second token-line frame, right after the blank boot frame; the README's mapping labels the sequence 'boot, standby, ...' but does not describe this frame's content - recorded here as the boot frame (a logo or early draw).

standby-no-codeplug.notes: Standby with no codeplug image, depending on the Null/battery display variant. docs/patch-patterns.md section 11 measures the upper end separately as 'standby-pattern-11' (4433-4437).

standby-pattern-11.notes: 'about 4433 non-black pixels and F5:4437 frame signatures' when booting a patched image to the standby frame under QEMU. Overlaps the upper end of 'standby-no-codeplug'; kept as its own entry because the two docs disagree.

menu-no-codeplug.notes: Main menu, with or without a codeplug (r69/r75). The snake run's menu frame (13309) and the blank-chip menu (13796, see 'menu-blank-chip') both fall here.

standby-blank-chip.notes: Standby with a blank SPI-NOR chip ('Null Ch.' twice). The snake run's standby frame (tools/examples/snake/README.md token line) is the same 13618.

menu-blank-chip.notes: Full menu with a blank chip (Talk Group, Scan, Zone, SMS, Call Log, Settings, Record, GNSS, APRS).

standby-generic-codeplug-vfo.notes: Standby with the generic codeplug in VFO mode (A 144.125 ANA, B 430.125 DIG).

menu-generic-codeplug-vfo.notes: Menu frames while stepping Up through the 3-row menu with the generic codeplug in VFO mode (rows Scan/Settings/GNSS). The doc states 'menu 11935-ish'; its token line shows F3:11935, F4:10830, F5:10820 - only those stated numbers are used for the range.

standby-generic-codeplug-channel.notes: Standby after a long press of Back switches the A side to channel mode ('Zone-Ana', 'CH 1', 431.125 MHz).

menu-generic-codeplug-channel.notes: Menu frames on the channel-mode path Menu > Zone > 'Zone List 1/3' > Zone-Ana > Channel List. The doc's token line lists 11530/11385/10669/11295/10773 - only those stated numbers are used for the range.

snake-category-sublist.source: docs/qemu-workflow.md 'Reading the results'; tools/examples/snake/README.md '2. Verify under QEMU'

snake-game.source: docs/qemu-workflow.md 'Reading the results'; tools/examples/snake/README.md '2. Verify under QEMU'
snake-game.notes: The snake game frame (1175 between each direction change in the snake token line).

snake-game-keyoverlay.notes: Snake game frames while a key is shown in the overlay (the readout changes the count). The snake token line's 1166/1138/1164/1142 all fall in this range.

after-back-stock-ui.notes: The snake run's stock UI after Back; 2993 and 2997 are the same screen 4 pixels apart (a blinking element). 2993 also appears once as an optional boot frame in the same token line (timing-dependent, may be absent).
